detailedNarrative: CASE034 (FIR/AMBALACITY/2025/0034) — Cyber Fraud (Online Investment Scam) registered at PS Ambala City, Ambala. Incident recorded on 2025-05-18 13:46 at Ambala City Residential Colony. FIR records 1 accused (Sandeep Singh P00149) and 3 named persons in total. 733 records across 5 sources; 15 transactions flagged for review. Money-flow records show funds received and forwarded within minutes (e.g. EVD-TXN004725 → EVD-TXN004726, 30.0 min), a pattern that can indicate layering and requires verification. Account UTIB-52701713023 received funds from 4 different individuals within 14 days. Communication between P00149 and P00427 spiked to 4 contacts within 3 hours on 2025-05-18.
